文学瞬间：让两个人的愿望都留在桌上。
心理：她把两种安排摊得很清楚，正要抚平纸角时停了一下：整齐的一版似乎把某个人真正想要的事藏掉了。 她愿意照顾关系，也不愿让自己或对方的愿望总是先退场。 她发现自己偏向的那一版，也值得坦率放到桌上。
目光：在两页之间停留，然后认真看向当事人。 先看两页，再看对方的反应。
相处：先把各自想保住的一点说实在，再谈承诺与代价。 把自己的偏向说清楚，留出对方的不同。
表情：眉眼从容，嘴角收下，思考时指尖有一点小动作。 认真里带一点温和的坚持。
光线：暖日光照纸与手，桌面层次清楚，不加装饰性图表。

Keep the youthful identifiable anime face and ordinary student proportions of her approved input: long LIGHT BROWN hair with softly curved side locks and gently curled ends, airy fine bangs, clear BLUE eyes and an observant delicate youthful face. Both eyes and bangs remain clearly drawn and visible. Faithful Tsukinomori uniform: dark NAVY sailor blouse with broad WHITE collar and fine navy trim, gray-blue bow with small GOLD school crest at throat, dark navy pleated knee-length skirt with TWO white hem lines, dark knee socks and BROWN loafers. A small chair rotation within its ORIGINAL footprint is enough; do not translate the chair into the walkway or move the lamp table. Let her face be naturally three-quarter rather than force her entire body frontally toward the viewer; avoid any extreme over-shoulder neck turn. Scale this desk-sitting figure to the original real chair, even if the desk depth makes her slightly smaller than the bench figure. One hand steadies a paper corner; the other rests nearby on the desk with the thumb and fingertip lightly touching in a small thoughtful gesture. Both arms connect naturally and receive real desk support. She has paused smoothing the paper and looks toward the off-camera companion, seriously but gently holding to a preference of her own. Quiet lips, composed brows, mild personal insistence rather than a hostess smile. No extreme neck/waist twist. The original chair seat supports her hips and its back stays behind the torso, skirt and knees connect correctly, lower legs and both complete brown loafers are visibly grounded near the chair. No cloned chair, standing-on-chair pose, floating stool, forearm through desktop or copied chat body; avoid the crossed-one-knee/two-parallel-feet ambiguity.

Scale, anatomy and finish: keep the newly approved close-camera human scale of this same character. A bench pose can have hair top around y=110 and shoes around y=850–900, with the precise shoe depth following the real seat position; the desk pose must follow its real chair and floor perspective rather than mechanically copy bench coordinates. Never enlarge the head, lean the face toward the lens, elongate shins or shrink furniture to force a number. Keep the entire hair, hands, knees, ankles and BOTH complete shoes in frame. Basic joints and the two legs must read continuously and independently; hands have coherent fingers and wrists, no fused limbs, no furniture penetration. Natural soft local contact shadows and honest occlusion. Subtle almond-gold clear-day window light, distinct local hair/skin/clothing colors, clear gentle facial shadow planes, natural white paper and ivory fabric. Refined anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the detailed literary room, no sticker edge, gray/gold overlay or new colored spotlight.
